value.rationale: The exact n-fold finite-subset and collapsed-suspension polynomial-entropy hierarchy for all irrational Sturmian minimal systems is a natural classification of a core symbolic-dynamical invariant outside the finite-chain-recurrence/wandering hypotheses of the motivating literature. Phase markers prevent real quotient loss, and unbounded layers yield infinite full-hyperspace polynomial entropy despite zero ordinary entropy at each finite level. It is not a numerical slice or known-table recomputation; its nontrivial point is a uniform Hausdorff separation through unlabeled sets and singleton collapse.
